newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese escudo pushes higher against mark.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese escudo pushes higher against mark.

text.p: The escudo was gaining against the mark in early trade, rising to 100.16/19 to the German currency, compared with its 100.18/21 close on Monday.

But traders said that the currency faced resistance at 100.10. If the resistance broke, the currency could test the figure. However, these further gains of the escudo were linked to the dollar edging higher towards 1.74 marks, they added.
"The strong dollar is boosting European currencies against the mark and as it approaches 1.74 (marks) it is making space for them to gain," said one trader.
